title: lycium arabicum
intro: Lycium arabicum, commonly known as Arabian boxthorn, is a shrub-like plant native to the Middle East and North Africa. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering various health benefits such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and anti-diabetic effects. The therapeutic actions of Lycium arabicum include its ability to protect the liver, improve cardiovascular health, and modulate the immune system. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
